content.stem: 以下哪项是金融情报机构(FIU)的核心职能,如金融行动特别工作组(FATF)第29号建议所述？

options.A: 资助先进科技监控工具的研发，以供全国使用
options.B: 起诉属于国家管辖范围内的重大洗钱或恐怖融资案件
options.C: 与私营部门共享从国家执法机构收集到的实时犯罪情报
options.D: 充当全国可疑活动收集与分析中心

content.stem_en: Which of the below is a core function of a financial intelligence unit (FIU), as described in FATF Recommendation 29?

options_en.A: Sponsoring the research and development of advanced technological surveillance tools to be used nationally
options_en.B: Prosecuting significant cases of money laundering or terrorist financing falling under national jurisdiction
options_en.C: Sharing real-time criminal intelligence gathered from national law enforcement agencies with the private sector
options_en.D: Serving as a national center for the collection and analysis of suspicious activity
